name: MPC MIDI Converter
author: 3dthc
summary: Converts MIDI files to MPC patterns right on the MPC, no computer needed. Browse your SD card and drives, convert one file or a whole pack with its subfolders, then load the patterns onto any track. Split tracks, map GM drums onto pads, quantize; each pattern's name carries the file's tempo. Gen1 (MPC OS 2.x and 3.x) and Gen2.
